name: plan-and-execute
title: Run a plan under a step budget

comparison.purpose: Bounded plan execution: a planner writes out the steps, each is worked through in order under a MAX_STEPS budget, and a solver composes the answer. If the plan needs more steps than the budget allows, the run ends in `failed` as soon as the plan arrives, with no worker calls spent, rather than answering from a plan it only partly executed.

starters: Plan a 3-day food tour of Tokyo on a $200 budget.
Figure out how many tennis balls fit inside a school bus.
Work out whether a heat pump makes sense for a 1920s house.

starters.label: Plan bigger than the budget (expect failed)

input.goal: Look up the population, median rent, and average January temperature of Lisbon, Berlin, and Austin.
